title: नेपालमा सार्वजनिक संस्थानको कार्यकुशलता र सुधारका उपायहरू  : Efficiency and Reform Measures of Public Enterprises in Nepal
nepali: देशको आर्थिक विकासका लागि आन्तरिक स्रोतको परिचालन गर्ने, नागरिकका आधारभूत आवश्यकता पूर्ति गर्ने, विकास योजनाका उद्धेश्यहरू हासिल गर्न सघाउ पुर्‍याउने, पूर्वाधार विकास गर्ने, मुलुकमा लगानीको वातावरण सिर्जना गर्ने, नयाँ प्रविधि भित्र्याउने, रोजगारी सिर्जना गर्ने, सरकारको सेवा प्रवाहको संवाहक (Delivery Wings of Government) को रूपमा कार्य गर्ने मूल उद्देश्यका साथ स्थापना भएका सार्वजनिक संस्थानको कार्य सम्पादनको स्तर, कार्यशैली र गुणात्मकताको अवस्था मिश्रित रहेको पाइन्छ। विश्व शासन प्रणालीमा आएको नवीन लहर, सरकारको कार्यक्षेत्र तथा भूमिकामा आएको फेरबदल, विज्ञान तथ प्रविधि र सूचना प्रविधिको क्षेत्रमा भएको अभूतपूर्व परिवर्तन, आर्थिक उदारीकरण र विश्वव्यापीकरणको कारण सिर्जित प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक वातावरण जस्ता विविध कारणले सार्वजनिक संस्थानका गतिविधिहरूमा पनि केही चुनौती तथा अवसरहरू खडा भए । यी चुनौतीहरूलाई अवसरमा बदल्ने र अवसरको पूर्ण उपयोग गरी यसबाट अत्यधिक फाइदा लिने कार्य प्रभावकारी हुन नसक्दा सार्वजनिक संस्थानप्रति जनमानसको पृथक धारणा रहेको पाइन्छ। समयानुसार यस्ता निकायहरूको आवश्यकता र औचित्यताका आधारमा सुधार तथा व्यवस्थापन गरी सेवा प्रवाहको संवाहक र आर्थिक वृद्धिको इन्जिन (Engine of Economic Growth) बनाउन सकेमा यसको लाभांश राज्यले लिन सक्दछ।
american_english: The performance level, work style, and quality status of public enterprises, which are established with the primary objectives of operating domestic resources for national economic development, meeting citizens' basic needs, helping achieve development plan targets, developing infrastructure, creating investment climate in the country, introducing new technology, creating employment, and serving as the government's delivery wings, are mixed. Various factors like new waves in world governance, changes in government scope and role, unprecedented changes in science, technology, and information technology sectors, economic liberalization and globalization creating competitive environments, have also brought some challenges and opportunities to public enterprise activities. Failure to turn these challenges into opportunities and fully utilize opportunities to gain maximum benefits means public enterprises are not performing effectively, leading to negative public perception. With this background, it's necessary to improve and manage such bodies according to their needs and justification to serve as delivery wings of government service and engines of economic growth so that the state can collect dividends from them.
british_english: Public enterprises, designed to harness domestic resources for economic growth, fulfil basic citizen requirements, advance development objectives, develop infrastructure, foster investment climate, introduce new technologies, generate employment, and operate as governmental delivery mechanisms, exhibit mixed performance, work methodologies, and quality standards. External factors including global governance trends, governmental restructuring, technological advancements, economic liberalization, and globalization have introduced both challenges and opportunities within public sector activities. Inability to transform challenges into opportunities and fully leverage potential benefits undermines public enterprise effectiveness, cultivating adverse public sentiment. This context necessitates the improvement and strategic management of such entities to function as governmental service delivery channels and economic growth engines, enabling the state to accrue tangible benefits.
australian_english: Public enterprises that are set up to use domestic resources for the country's economic growth, meet citizens' basic needs, help reach development plan targets, build infrastructure, create an investment climate in the country, introduce new technology, create jobs, and act as the government's delivery wings, have a mixed level of performance, work style and quality. Various factors such as the new wave in world governance, changes in the scope and role of government, unprecedented changes in the science and technology and information technology sectors, economic liberalization and globalization creating a competitive environment, have also brought some challenges and opportunities to public enterprise activities. Failure to turn challenges into opportunities and fully utilize the opportunities to gain maximum benefits means public enterprises are not performing effectively, leading to negative public perception. Given this context, it is necessary to improve and manage such bodies according to their needs and justification to serve as delivery wings of government service and engines of economic growth so that the state can collect dividends from them.
informal_english: Public enterprises are these organizations that are created to use the country's own resources to grow the economy, meet basic needs of citizens, help reach development goals, build infrastructure, create an investment-friendly environment, bring in new tech, create jobs, and act as the government's service delivery arms. However, their performance, how they work, and their quality are all over the place - some good, some not so good. External factors like changes in global governance, shifts in what governments do and how they operate, huge advances in science and technology, economic liberalization, and globalization creating a competitive marketplace have brought both challenges and opportunities for these public enterprises. If they can't turn challenges into opportunities and make the most of the chances they get, they're not doing well, and people start viewing them negatively. Given this situation, we need to improve and manage these organizations based on what they actually need and make sense for them to do, so they can serve as the government's service delivery arms and engines for economic growth, and the state can benefit from them.
